title: Governed lexical search request (governed-search-v0)
description: Body for a successful POST /v0/search. Clients should send the named object form, not rely on positional deserialization. JSON body limit: 2 MiB. The daemon also checks query grammar, UTF-8 byte and term limits, and the signed capability; schema validity is not authorization.

oneOf.description: The Rust struct deserializer also accepts a positional array, in the order q, mode, filters, limit, cursor. Omitted trailing fields take the same defaults as the object form.

query.description: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, 128 whitespace-delimited terms and 128 evidence terms. maxLength is only a code point ceiling; clients must check the UTF-8 byte count separately. Lexical syntax and optional leading in:<field> and ><field> controls are checked by the daemon.

mode.description: Send explicitly. Omission defaults to hybrid internally, which, like semantic, is unsupported in the governed profile.

limit.description: Must also be at most the signed max_limit, even when this field is omitted. Encode as an integer literal, not a fraction or exponent.

cursor.description: Omit or send null. String cursors parse but are rejected as unavailable.

oneOf.description: Positional serde form, in order vault_id, room, path_prefix, tags, frontmatter_equals.

vault_filter.description: Exact narrowing match against signed vault IDs; not subject to the signed ID-format check.

room_filter.description: Exact narrowing match against signed room_id values; not subject to the signed ID-format check.

path_prefix.description: Nonempty room-relative prefix, no initial slash, backslash, NUL or '..' component. A trailing slash is accepted.
